variableMeasured.name: Condition
variableMeasured.description: Statement type (Reality, Knowledge, Belief) crossed with the correct answer (Y = yes, N = no).

variableMeasured.name: Stimulus
variableMeasured.description: Relative path to the trial image. Associated files can be found under /materials.

variableMeasured.name: Statement
variableMeasured.description: Text of the statement presented on a given trial, exactly as displayed to the participant.

variableMeasured.name: CorAnsOdd
variableMeasured.description: Correct response key for odd-numbered participants (key-mapping counterbalancing).

variableMeasured.name: CorAnsEven
variableMeasured.description: Correct response key for even-numbered participants (key-mapping counterbalancing).

variableMeasured.name: TypeOfStimuli
variableMeasured.description: Epistemic structure of the scene in the image. TB/FB = true/false belief; K = knowledge; Ig = ignorance; B = barrier.

variableMeasured.name: TotalShapesOnTable
variableMeasured.description: Total number of shapes (cubes & pyramids) present on the table in the image.

variableMeasured.name: TotalcubesOnTable
variableMeasured.description: Total number of cubes (target objects) present on the table in the image.

variableMeasured.name: TotalOtherOnTable
variableMeasured.description: Total number of pyramids (distractors) present on the table.

variableMeasured.name: VisibleShapes
variableMeasured.description: Total number of shapes visible to the agent (not occluded by the barrier).

variableMeasured.name: Visiblecubes
variableMeasured.description: Number of cubes (target objects) visible to the agent.

variableMeasured.name: VisibleOther
variableMeasured.description: Number of pyramids (distractors) visible to the agent.

variableMeasured.name: NotVisibleShapes
variableMeasured.description: Total number of shapes not visible to the agent (occluded by the barrier).

variableMeasured.name: NotVisiblecubes
variableMeasured.description: Number of cubes (target objects) occluded from the agent.

variableMeasured.name: NotVisibleOther
variableMeasured.description: Number of pyramids (distractors) occluded from the agent.

variableMeasured.name: NumOfBlocksAsked
variableMeasured.description: Number of cubes asserted in the statement.

variableMeasured.name: BarrierPresent
variableMeasured.description: Whether an occluding barrier was present in the scene (B) or absent (NB).

variableMeasured.name: WhyNo
variableMeasured.description: Reason the correct answer is 'no': the proposition is false, or it is true but the agent lacks the relevant knowledge or belief. '-' for 'yes' trials.

variableMeasured.name: Position
variableMeasured.description: Table positions occupied by each shape; S/T = square/triangle, followed by a location code. Multiple shapes are colon-separated.

variableMeasured.name: Colour
variableMeasured.description: Colour of each shape; S/T = square/triangle, followed by a colour initial (B = blue, G = green, O = orange, P = purple, R = red, Y = yellow). Multiple shapes are colon-separated.

variableMeasured.name: ExpTrial.thisRepN
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy indexing - always 0 in this case as there was only 1 repeat.

variableMeasured.name: ExpTrial.thisTrialN
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy reported zero-indexed trial number - identical to ExpTrial.thisN.

variableMeasured.name: ExpTrial.thisN
variableMeasured.description: Identical to ExpTrial.thisTrialN - redundant column from PsychoPy.

variableMeasured.name: ExpTrial.thisIndex
variableMeasured.description: Row index of the condition file supplying the trials parameters. Condition file can be found under /materials.

variableMeasured.name: ExpIntroText.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the instruction text.

variableMeasured.name: ExpIntroPressSPACEText.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the instruction continue prompt.

variableMeasured.name: ExpIntroPressSPACE.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the instruction keyboard component.

variableMeasured.name: ExpIntroPressSPACE.keys
variableMeasured.description: Key pressed to advance past the instructions.

variableMeasured.name: ExpIntroPressSPACE.rt
variableMeasured.description: Time taken to advance past the instructions, from onset of the instruction keyboard component.

variableMeasured.name: ExpPrimerText.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the primer text.

variableMeasured.name: ExpTextISI.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the inter-stimulus interval preceding the statement text.

variableMeasured.name: ExpPrimerText.stopped
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Offset time of the primer text.

variableMeasured.name: ExpText.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the statement.

variableMeasured.name: ExpImageISI.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the inter-stimulus interval preceding the trial image.

variableMeasured.name: ExpImagePrimer.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the image primer.

variableMeasured.name: ExpImagePrimer.stopped
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Offset time of the image primer.

variableMeasured.name: ExpImage.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the trial image.

variableMeasured.name: ExpResponse.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the response keyboard component.

variableMeasured.name: ExpResponse.keys
variableMeasured.description: Participant response - key pressed in response to the statement-image pair.

variableMeasured.name: ExpResponse.corr
variableMeasured.description: Response accuracy: 1 = correct, 0 = incorrect.

variableMeasured.name: ExpResponse.rt
variableMeasured.description: Primary dependent variable - response time, measured from onset of the trial image.

variableMeasured.name: BreakTextPrompt.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the break prompt text.

variableMeasured.name: BreakTextPrompt.stopped
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Offset time of the break prompt text.

variableMeasured.name: BreakTextKeyResponse.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the break keyboard component.

variableMeasured.name: BreakTextKeyResponse.stopped
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Offset time of the break keyboard component.

variableMeasured.name: BreakTextKeyResponse.keys
variableMeasured.description: Key pressed to end the break; 'NA' on trials with no break.

variableMeasured.name: BreakTextKeyResponse.rt
variableMeasured.description: Time taken to end the break, from onset of the break keyboard component.

variableMeasured.name: ExpEndText.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the end-of-experiment text.

variableMeasured.name: ExpEndPressSPACE.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the end-of-experiment keyboard component.

variableMeasured.name: ExpEndPressSPACE.keys
variableMeasured.description: Key pressed to exit the experiment.

variableMeasured.name: ExpEndPressSPACE.rt
variableMeasured.description: Time taken to exit the experiment, from onset of the end-of-experiment keyboard component.

variableMeasured.name: ExpEndText.stopped
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Offset time of the end-of-experiment text.

variableMeasured.name: ExpEndPressSPACE.stopped
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Offset time of the end-of-experiment keyboard component.

variableMeasured.name: participant
variableMeasured.description: Anonymised participant number.

variableMeasured.name: session
variableMeasured.description: Testing session number - always 1.

variableMeasured.name: date
variableMeasured.description: Date and time the session was started.

variableMeasured.name: expName
variableMeasured.description: Name of the assocaited PsychoPy experiment file.

variableMeasured.name: psychopyVersion
variableMeasured.description: Version of PsychoPy used to run the experiment.

variableMeasured.name: frameRate
variableMeasured.description: Measured refresh rate of the display at the start of the session as captured by PsychoPy.
